items.title: NTE codes October 2026
items.summary: Our list of Neverness to Everness (NTE) codes and 1.2 livestream codes will help you claim free Annulith, which will help you roll for new S-Class characters.
items.content:
Image credit: Hotta Studio Guide by Dion Dassanayake Contributing Guides Writer Updated on Oct. 28, 2026, 3:50 p.m. Follow Neverness to Everness Prioritise us on Google 28th October 2026 : We added new NTE livestream codes. Neverness to Everness codes will help you claim free Annulith so you can roll for new characters in the GTA-like gacha game. The free-to-play RPG is set in a Tokyo-like metropolis known as Hethereau, where supernatural events known as Anomalies occur.

While it's up to you to hunt down these Anomalies, the game is all about player freedom and there's tonnes of other things you can do including street races, taking on part-time jobs and buying your own luxury apartment. There's even a GTA-style wanted system and you can end up in jail! If you need a hand on your adventures, you can always use NTE codes to get rewards like free Annulith which will help you roll for new S-Class characters. Codes are shared on the official NTE Discord server , but to save you time we've rounded up the latest codes below including the NTE 1.5 livestream codes .

Here are all the working NTE codes as of 28th October 2026:

Think we can make our code pages better? Help us level up by taking our quick survey .

Neverness to Everness players can also claim free rewards that were shared in the 1.5 livestream. These NTE livestream codes are only available for a limited amount of time, so you need to be quick in redeeming them!

The NTE 1.5 livestream codes, which were shared in an online broadcast that detailed the 'Once Upon a Glitched Call' update , will only be available until Sunday 1st November 2026 at 3.59pm GMT.

Not sure how to redeem codes in Neverness to Everness? Here's what you need to do:

Run out of NTE codes to redeem? If you pre-registered for NTE then you'll have plenty of extra freebies waiting for you in your inbox.

Simply head to the 'Mail' section and find the message titled 'Pre-Reg Milestone Rewards' to claim the goodies. Here's everything you can get if you pre-registered:

Besides NTE codes, you can also get freebies for Neverness to Everness at launch by taking advantage of Twitch Drops. Twitch Drops let you claim rewards for NTE by watching participating streams.

If this sounds like something you're interested in, then here's what you need to do:

The number of rewards you get depends on how long you watch a participating stream. Here's the NTE rewards you can get and how long you need to watch a Twitch stream to get it:

Once you've unlocked a reward, you'll need to head to your Twitch Drops Inventory and claim it so you receive it in-game.

At launch NTE players can also claim the A-Class Aurelia character for free. Aurelia is a login bonus for Neverness to Everness, and all you need to do to get the character is login to NTE for three consecutive days.

items.title: Everything revealed for Neverness to Everness Version 1.5–Exe, Elyms, vehicles, events
items.summary: NTE's Version 1.5 will introduce new S-Class characters, two new vehicles, fresh events, and more.
items.content:
All News NTE Version 1.5 brings characters Exe and Elyms, plus new vehicles and events (Image: Hotta Studio).

{" "} Everything revealed for Neverness to Everness Version 1.5–Exe, Elyms, vehicles, events .iframe-media {width: 100%;aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} .img-media {width: 100%;aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} .a-img-media {aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} NTE's Version 1.5 will introduce new S-Class characters, two new vehicles, fresh events, and more. Neverness to Everness (NTE) has unveiled everything coming in Version 1.5, titled “Once Upon a Glitched Call”. The update will embrace a tech-themed aesthetic, which ties in with its upcoming characters, ETD-6 Lieutenant Elyms and Captain Exe .

Appraisers will embark on a new story exploring the “friction” between the ETD-6 leaders, leading them into a new anomalous realm featuring its own unique boss. In addition, two new vehicles have been revealed, alongside a fresh line-up of events and activities.

We break down everything coming to NTE Version 1.5, as revealed during the livestream, below.

Version 1.5 kicks off with Elyms’ limited-time banner, “Android Dreams”, running from 11 November to 2 December. Her featured Arc banner, “Echo Special”, will run for the same duration, featuring her signature Arc, “Echoes on Hold”.

Elyms is an S-Class Cosmos Esper described as bubbly and easygoing. She will join the ranks of the game’s Cosmos characters, including Zero, Hotori, and Shinku. Her Arc compatibility is Solid, allowing her to use Arcs such as Reality Refuge and Day Off. However, her signature Arc, “Echoes on Hold”, would be the best option. As a Burst DPS, she also provides DMG Boost support for the team.

If you’re planning to pull for Elyms, start farming the following materials to level her up as soon as possible.

At launch, Elyms will also have three outfits. Drifting Petals can be obtained by reaching the required number of pulls on her banner, while Windflower unlocks when you reach Bond Level 10. Her third outfit, “Y2K Mystique”, can be purchased directly from the Mall.

Elyms is voiced by Crystal Lee, who also voices Clorinde in Genshin Impact, Jean Grey in Marvel Rivals, and Alexandrina Sebastiane in Zenless Zone Zero.

Exe’s limited-time banner, “Offline Equations”, will arrive in the second half of NTE Version 1.5 along with his Arc banner “Encryption Special”, which features his signature Arc “Dotted Horizon”.

Despite working closely with Elyms to lead ETD-6, Exe is her polar opposite. Cold and level-headed, he is also said to be an elite hacker who operates under an alias.

Exe is a Chaos Esper, making him only the third character with this Esper element, alongside Daffodil and Lacrimosa. His Arc compatibility is Plasma, allowing him to use Arcs such as Raging Flames and Song of the Whale. However, his signature Arc, “Dotted Horizon”, is expected to be his best option. Exe specialises in Main DPS and is a Summoner.

If you’re planning to pull for Exe, start farming the following materials to level him up as soon as possible.

Exe will also receive three outfits at launch. Blue Snow can be obtained by reaching the required number of pulls on his banner, while X% unlocks at Bond Level 10. His third outfit, “Untouched by Rain”, can be purchased directly from the Mall.

items.title: Tank Battles Come to Neverness to Everness! Version 1.5 Livestream Recap Featuring Elyms and Exe
items.summary: On Wednesday, October 28 at 8:30 PM, the Version 1.5 preview special program for 'Neverness to Everness,' titled 'Once Upon a Glitched Call,' was broadcast via the official YouTube channel.
items.content:
November 11 Update, New Story, Logistics Management, and Animal Vehicles

Korean (한국어) KO Add us on On Wednesday, October 28 at 8:30 PM, the Version 1.5 preview special program for 'Neverness to Everness,' titled 'Once Upon a Glitched Call,' was broadcast via the official YouTube channel. The livestream unveiled new S-Rank characters Elyms and Exe, alongside a main story set in digital space, logistics center management, tank battles, and other new content. Version 1.5 will update on November 11 and run until December 23, with Phase 1 and Phase 2 lasting 21 days each .

3 Special Livestream Redeem Codes for 300 Total Annuliths

Three redemption codes were revealed during the stream: INVALIDNUMBER, HOLDFRIEND, and EXENORESPONSE. Each code awards 100 Annuliths alongside growth materials, and all expire on November 2 at 16:59 (KST) . To claim the rewards, players must have the in-game mailbox unlocked before the expiration deadline.

The new main story 'Meet Me in the Data Stream' begins with an urban legend spreading through Hethereau known as the 'Unassigned Number.' People meet a long-lost friend in a dream, but upon waking, only a single phone number remains in their memory. Calling the number returns only an automated message stating that the number does not exist. Although connection is impossible, the number lingers stubbornly in mind, accompanied by growing reports of others experiencing the exact same phenomenon.

Involved in the incident are Exe, captain of ETD Team 6—a unit specializing in information technology—and Lieutenant Elyms. Mysterious aspects of the Bureau's response are revealed, including the two directly leaving warning comments on posts regarding the rumor. The relationship between the two and the mysteries surrounding Elyms are also key points to explore in this story.

The stage of the adventure expands into a massive network space connected to the 'Unassigned Number.' It features everything from a submerged city lined with block-shaped buildings above and below the digital sea to spaces reminiscent of old computers and operating system windows. In this realm where even single pebbles are composed of data, battles against boss-level Anomalies have also been teased.

ETD Team 6 Leaders, Elyms and Exe Join the Roster

Light-Attribute Rapid Cycle Elyms and Dark-Attribute Ranged DPS Exe

The new S-Rank character in the first half, Elyms, is the lieutenant of ETD Team 6. Bubbly and playful, she excels at mediating conflicts and soothing others' feelings. The smartphone she never lets go of in daily life transforms into a secret weapon when entering battle.

As a Light attribute character, Elyms features the 'Rapid Cycle' trait where using her Birail Skill instantly maxes out her cycle meter. She supports the party with passive effects that enhance Charge and Remora, while managing 'Signal Strength' in battle. The mechanic involves completing normal attack chains at weak signal strength to prepare enhanced skills, then using support and enhanced skills to raise signal levels from normal to strong.

Her Ultimate switches between single-target and area-of-effect attacks based on the number of enemies detected beforehand. The stronger the signal at activation, the higher the damage dealt by her Ultimate and subsequent joint attacks, while providing an ATK buff to party members except herself. After using her Ultimate, she can continue performing off-field joint attacks for a set duration.

In the second half, Exe, captain of ETD Team 6 and a hidden hacker, joins the lineup. Expressionless and efficiency-minded, he quietly takes on tasks others avoid. In the open world, players can utilize his Esper ability to travel between billboards.

Exe's combat centers around 'Frames' and 'Ranks.' He stacks frames with attacks and outputs Digital Spectrums to inflict additional damage. Executing continuous attacks, skills, Extreme Evasions, and counterattacks increases his rank from B to A, S, SS, and SSS, with higher ranks allowing him to accumulate frames more efficiently.

The "Dazzling Star" Limited Board is coming soon! Roll for a chance to get Akane Rin, the featured limited S-class character!

● Available

October 21, 2026 (after update) – November 11, 2026, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Complete the Episode Quest "Prologue: A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

1. The "Dazzling Star" board features the limited S-class character Akane Rin, along with A-class characters Haniel, Aurelia, and Skia.

2. Also on the "Dazzling Star" board: "Day Adrift" glider, "Starbeat Rush" Yesteryear bike livery, and Akane's "Shining Idol" outfit.

1. The "Dazzling Star" board uses Solid Dice or Void Dice. Roll to move 1–6 tiles (equal chance), land on a tile, and claim the displayed reward.

4. All boards start as Baseline. If the featured S-class character doesn't drop within 70 consecutive rolls, the board upgrades to Modified (rate up). Once you obtain the featured S-class character, the board resets to Baseline.

5. If you haven't obtained the featured S-class character after 89 rolls, your 90th roll automatically grants them (your piece will not move). The featured S-class character is guaranteed within 90 rolls.

6. Akane Rin is currently only available from the "Dazzling Star" Limited Board, with no other ways to obtain her planned at this time.

items.title: ‘Neverness to Everness’ Version 1.4's Second-half Kicks Off 21 Oct., "God Knows..." Collab Trailer
items.summary: Last Friday, developer Hotta World and publisher Perfect World Games announced that the second-half of their Version 1.4 update will kick off on 21
items.content:
Last Friday, developer Hotta World and publisher Perfect World Games announced that the second-half of their Version 1.4 update will kick off on 21 October in their free-to-play open-world urban adventure title ‘NTE: Neverness to Everness’. Headlining the update is new playable character Akane Rin, a part-time guitarist at Livehouse StarSign whose past as an Anomaly Hunter is waiting to be uncovered. She arrives alongside a new school festival story featuring The Whoots!!!! and a special performance of the beloved anime song “God knows…” . Yeah, you read that right—time to party like it’s 2008, dood. Shake the melancholy away. Oh, and this update also marks NTE’s half-year anniversary, with players able to claim 2 million Fons and Akane Rin’s “House Special” outfit as part of the celebrations.

Akane Rin may be best known as a part-time guitarist at Livehouse StarSign, but her life hasn’t always followed the same tune. Once an Anomaly Hunter, Akane Rin’s past and the events that led her to the stage are waiting to be uncovered.

Akane Rin joins the playable roster with three new outfits, including the “House Special” outfit available as an anniversary reward. Her love of music also carries over into the open world, allowing players to pull out her guitar and perform wherever they like while exploring Hethereau.

A new school festival story also begins, bringing players back together with The Whoots!!!! as they prepare for their latest performance.

As part of a special song collaboration, the band will perform the beloved anime song “God knows…”. Players can join the festivities, catch up with the group and discover where their story takes them next.

To mark NTE’s half-year anniversary, players can claim 2 million Fons alongside Akane Rin’s “House Special” outfit when the second half of Version 1.4 begins on October 21. These rewards follow the gifts introduced with the first half of Version 1.4, including:

The first half of Version 1.4 launched on September 30, introducing NTE’s second Porsche collaboration, the fully explorable Pukaland theme park, playable character Blackbird and new permanent Anomaly Commissions. Players can now drive the Porsche 911 Turbo (930), Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package and returning Porsche 918 Spyder, with further customisation available through the Porsche Club.

Pukaland offers four zones filled with rides, minigames and rewards, while Blackbird can transform into a bird and take to the skies for a new way to explore Hethereau. Players can also investigate a series of supernatural encounters, including the mysterious Ghost Bus, a monster-filled dream and a world of suddenly enormous everyday objects.

NTE: Neverness to Everness is available across PC (Windows/macOS/Linux via Proton), PlayStation 5, and mobile platforms .

During the event, complete limited-time encounters to earn Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Floe Cinema Tickets, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

●Pukaland Gameplay Overview

Candy Jar Raid

"In Candy Jar Raid, press the corresponding Movement keys to rotate your view, and hold the Shoot key to fire. Switch between Cannonballs and Forks depending on the situation.

Use Cannonballs to knock back approaching octopus tentacles and protect the cup's Durability. Use Forks to collect Treasure Chests and Treasure Maps for points. Be careful—if the cup's Durability reaches zero, the game will end early with a low rating."

"If a powerful tentacle grabs you, quickly repel the other attacking tentacles to avoid losing a large amount of points and durability.

Collect all Treasure Maps to unlock a special challenge stage. Defeat all Golden Tentacles to clear the challenge and unlock a special ending. Give it your all!"

Flora Maze

"In Flora Maze, players spawn at random locations, and the maze layout changes each round.

Explore the maze, find the exit, and escape! Collect all the scattered playing cards and rescue every trapped Pukaboo to earn additional rewards."

"Lollipop Goggles reveal the location of the exit, but also make the timer run faster. Pick up other items to gain more time. Approach special bushes to uncover hidden paths—but be careful, some bushes move on their own!

If you fail to escape before time runs out, the challenge will end early with a low rating. Good luck out there!"

Pixies Waltz

"In Pixies Waltz, press the corresponding direction when the green cursor reaches the center of the button to build Firepower.

Your timing will be rated Perfect, Normal, or Miss."

"Reach the top of the tower to enter first-person shooting mode. Spend Firepower to shoot down airborne candy and earn points!

If half of the Firepower you gain in a single run is earned with a Perfect rating, a special challenge stage will unlock. Clear it to reach the special ending. Give it your best shot!"

Punchulum Ride

"In the Punchulum Ride, press the corresponding Movement key when each circle appears to earn points.

There are three types of inputs: press, hold, and repeated press. Watch the colors carefully to know which one to use.

Pink Candy Ring: Press once

Blue Candy Ring: Hold

Orange Candy Ring: Press repeatedly"

"Mistakes increase your character's Fear, while successful inputs reduce it. If Fear gets too high, the game will end early and you'll receive a low rating.

Land multiple Perfects to unlock a special challenge stage. Clear it to reach the special ending. Give it your best shot!"

Lavaton Gold Rush

In Lavaton Gold Rush, use the Movement and Jump keys to control the mine cart. Switch between adjacent tracks to dodge obstacles, pick up weapons to destroy them, and collect coins to earn points.

"While airborne, you can steer the mine cart left or right to choose which track to land on, though your movement will be limited during lava eruptions. On steep tracks, press the Speed Up key to make it up the slope.

Hitting obstacles or derailing will cost you points. Lose too many points, and the game will end early with a low score."

● Available

Complete the Episode Quest "Prologue: A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

items.summary: Hey Appraiser, NTE will undergo maintenance on September 30 from 06:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8). Once it's done, the all-new Version 1.4 "For Whom the Verses Mourn" will go live! ▶Check out NTE Version 1.4 PV on YouTube: Along with new content and
items.content:
Hey Appraiser,

NTE will undergo maintenance on September 30 from 06:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8). Once it's done, the all-new Version 1.4 "For Whom the Verses Mourn" will go live!

▶Check out NTE Version 1.4 PV on YouTube:

Along with new content and events, this update is packed with rewards from start to finish. Here's what's in store:

\

1. "Circle Gifts" Login Event

Duration: September 30 (after update) – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Log in for a total of 7 days to earn Solid Dice x10.

2.Pukaland Fest Special Gift Pack

After the version update on September 30, 2026 (UTC+8), claim Solid Dice x10 and the "Like Clockwork" avatar frame from your mail.

After the second update on October 21, 2026 (UTC+8), claim Akane's "House Special" outfit and Fons x2,000,000 from your mail.

Eligibility: Appraisers who have created a character and unlocked the Mail feature before Version 1.4 ends.

3.City Tycoon: "Puka Membership Program"

Available: After the Version 1.4 update

Details: Once the "Puka Membership Program" opens, complete its quest series and raise your Sweetdream Level to unlock "Puka Boot Camp", "Drone Follow-Cam", Sakiri's new outfit "Gingerbear Biscuit", Baicang's new outfit "Master Slacker", Haniel's new outfit "Classroom Hijinks", an S-Class Standard Character Selection Box, a "Puka Membership" S-Class Arc Selection Box, the accessories "Moonless Night" and "Grand Prize", the avatar frame "Cha-Ching!", the namecard "Fons Legend", the title "Puka Tycoon" and phone wallpaper "Making It Rain", the dice skins "Doooonut" and "Puka-Pukaboo", and more!

※ Open the "Puka Membership" S-Class Arc Selection Box to choose one of these Arcs: Reality Refuge, Youthful Fantasy, Good Boy's Grand Adventure, Camellia Society, Raging Flames, Blow up the Crowd, Tears Beneath the Mask, Eternal Waltz, or Song of the Whale.

\

1. New Character & Arc

● New Limited S-Class Character: Blackbird

Available: September 30 (after update) – October 21, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Board Details: The "Foretold Finale" Limited Board features S-class character Blackbird, alongside A-class characters Mint, Edgar, and Adler.

During the event, the "Foretold Finale" Limited Board features "The Harbinger" glider livery, the "Nightplume" Yesteryear bike livery, and Blackbird's "Rouge et Noir" outfit. The Divination Perks event runs alongside the board, so you can claim these rewards directly from the event page once you reach 50/120/200 cumulative rolls, or obtain them randomly through rolls before reaching these milestones.

*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.

● New Limited S-Class Arc: "Crime and Punishment"

Available: September 30 (after update) – October 21, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Research Guide: Spend Tri-Keys or Roostfeather Keys to participate in the "Roostfeather Special" Arc Research Program and obtain the limited S-Class Arc "Crime and Punishment". This Arc is currently only available through this program.

*For full details, head to Arc Shop › Arc Research Program in-game.

● Limited S-Class Character Lacrimosa Returns

Available: September 30 (after update) – October 21, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Board Details: The "Fading Reverie" Limited Board features S-class character Lacrimosa, alongside A-class characters Mint, Edgar, and Adler.

During the event, the "Fading Reverie" Limited Board features the "Tomato Duo" glider livery, the "Tomato Cruise" Regalia Pendragon livery, and Lacrimosa's "Gilded Rhapsody" outfit. Claim them from the Daydream Perks page by accumulating 50/120/200 rolls, or obtain them randomly through rolls before reaching these milestones.

※ Only rolls on the "Fading Reverie" Limited Board count toward Daydream Perks progress. Each board is tracked independently, and progress carries over between boards with the same name.

*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.

● Limited S-Class Arc "The Last Rose" Returns

Available: September 30 (after update) – October 21, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Research Guide: Spend Tri-Keys or Nocturne Keys to participate in the "Nocturne Special" Arc Research Program and obtain the limited S-Class Arc "The Last Rose". This Arc is currently only available through this program.

*For full details, head to Arc Shop › Arc Research Program in-game.

2. New Story

● New Main Story Episode: "The Witch"

A mysterious letter. A sinister ritual. A town shrouded in secrets...

Fear clouds eyes that should see clearly, and no fire can burn away the shadow of the curse.

In the lull between endless trials, the bewildered townsfolk whisper:

"Witch, witch, where are you?"

Available: After the Version 1.4 update

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story episode "Fogden Game"

● City Hangouts

A new City Hangouts story featuring Blackbird

Available: After the Version 1.4 update

Unlock Requirement: Obtain Blackbird and reach the required Bond Level

● Home Time

A new Invitation mode featuring Blackbird.

Available: After the Version 1.4 update

Unlock Requirement: Obtain Blackbird and reach the required Bond Level

3. New Locations

● New Location: Pukaland

Where joy gathers, anything can happen.

Welcome to Pukaland! Make the most of everything it has to offer. Adventures, chance encounters, even the occasional unbelievable fairy tale: embrace them all and write your own story!

● New Location: St. Arbor

A town at the foot of the mountain, once a quiet place where people lived and worked in peace.

4. New Outfits & Accessories

● New Blackbird Outfit "Wandering Stars" Added to Shop

Discount Period: October 7, 06:30 – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Discount Price: Riftcrystal x2,680

Original Price: Riftcrystal x3,280 (18% off, limited time)

Available: October 7, 06:30 (UTC+8)

Shop Availability: Permanent

● New Blackbird Outfit "Rouge et Noir"

How to Get: While the "Foretold Finale" Limited Board is active, roll on the board and land on the matching tile to obtain the outfit, or claim it from the Divination Perks page once you've accumulated enough rolls.

● New Blackbird Outfit "Unfazed Denim"

How to Get: Unlocked after you obtain Blackbird and reach Bond Lvl 10 with her.

● New Outfits: Sakiri's "Gingerbear Biscuit", Baicang's "Master Slacker", and Haniel's "Classroom Hijinks"

How to Get: Unlock by reaching the required level in City Tycoon: "Puka Membership Program".

● New Accessories: "Tomorrow's Star", "Position Zero", and "Neon Nights"

Price: Fons x1,600,000

How to Get: Purchase in Mall › Fashion Shop.

● New Accessories: "Moonless Night" and "Grand Prize"

How to Get: Unlock by reaching the required level in City Tycoon: "Puka Membership Program".

● New Accessory: "Big Brains"

How to Get: Redeem at the Star Ticket Counter in Pukaland.

● New Accessory: "Knockingbird"

How to Get: Unlock by earning a specific achievement.

5. NTE × Porsche Collab Begins!

● New Mystery Box Event: "Born to Race"

Available: September 30 (after update) – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Spend Fons or Annulith to open "Born to Race" Mystery Boxes. Your first box costs Fons x50,000 or Annulith x50, and the price climbs with each one after. There are 15 boxes in total, and opening all of them unlocks every reward in the pool.

Mystery Box Contents: "Born to Race" Mystery Boxes feature the brand-new Porsche collab vehicles "Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package" and "Porsche 911 Turbo (930)", Fabricated Dice, A Handwritten Letter, Fons, the limited avatar frame "Redline Rush", the exclusive namecard "Roar Recharged", and more.

※ Note: Vehicles obtained from Collab Mystery Boxes do not include a signature nameplate.

● "Everdriving" Mystery Boxes Return

Available: September 30 (after update) – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Spend Fons or Annulith to open "Everdriving" Mystery Boxes. Your first box costs Fons x50,000 or Annulith x50, and the price climbs with each one after. There are 15 boxes in total, and opening all of them unlocks every reward in the pool.

Mystery Box Contents: "Everdriving" Mystery Boxes feature the Porsche collab vehicle "Porsche 918 Spyder", Esper Zero's limited collab outfit "Perfect Partners", Fabricated Dice x10, A Handwritten Letter x3, Fons x500,000, the limited avatar frame "Heartbeat Moment", the exclusive namecard "Trackside Shadow", and more.

※ Your previous "Everdriving" Mystery Box progress carries over, so you can pick up right where you left off.

※ Note: Vehicles obtained from Collab Mystery Boxes do not include a signature nameplate.

● "Porsche Club" Now Open

Appraisers, welcome to the "Porsche Club"!

After the update, owning any of the Porsche collab vehicles above unlocks the matching Club Perks:

"Porsche 918 Spyder": Unlocks "Power Boost", a modification for Porsche collab vehicles.

"Porsche 911 Turbo (930)": Unlocks "Salzburg", a classic livery for Porsche collab vehicles.

"Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package": Unlocks the Porsche collab furniture "Badge of Honor", the namecard "Horizon Spectre", the phone case "No Substitute", the phone wallpaper "Relentless Drive", and the title "Porsche Club".

6. New Events

● "Pukaland Travelogue" Limited-Time Event

Duration: September 30 (after update) – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Welcome to Pukaland, where your magical journey begins! Collect Wonder Stamps and unlock your exclusive park memories. During the event, complete limited-time encounters to earn Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Floe Cinema Tickets, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

● "Terminal Depths" Limited-Time Event

Duration: September 30 (after update) – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Dear passengers, we are now approaching ** Station. Clear stages during the event to earn the title "Off-Rail Operator", Annulith, Fons, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

● "Coal Lump's Treasure" Limited-Time Event

Duration: October 8, 10:00 – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Keep those grubby little paws off Coal Lump's treasures! Take part during the event to earn the event currency "Prism Drop", and reach the target high scores to unlock the titles "Sweet Benefactor" and "Bestie Supreme". You can also visit the event shop to exchange for Annulith, Floe Cinema Tickets, Fons, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

● "Stamina Recharge" Limited-Time Event

Duration: October 5, 05:00 – October 19, 04:59 (server time)

Details: During the event, spend City Stamina at 2x efficiency in "Hethereau Hobbies" activities.

● "Pixel Surge" Limited-Time Event

Duration: October 19, 05:00 – October 26, 04:59 (server time)

Details: During the event, spend Character Pixels in "Houdinii's Magic Stage", "Houdinii's Schemes", "Bubble Can Factory", and "Rabbit Hole" to receive double the rewards.

Each day, double rewards apply to up to 120 Character Pixels spent. Unused daily allowance carries over, up to a total cap of 840 Character Pixels for the whole event.

7. Other Content

● New Anomaly Commissions

Available after the version update on September 30 (UTC+8): "Night of the Last Bus", "Lilliput in the Looking Glass", and "Perfectly Ordinary Dreams"

Available after the second update on October 21 (UTC+8): "No Rest for the Cookies"

● Version 1.4 "Circle Bounty" Guide

Available: September 30 (after update) – November 10, 23:59 (UTC+8)

Requirement: Complete the Main Quest "Relax Time"

Details: During the event, complete Circle Quests to earn Experience Points and raise your Circle Bounty Rank, unlocking Fabricated Dice, Gold Carrota, De-noise Solution, A Handwritten Letter, Eternal Shell Song, Development EXP Selection Box I, Expansion Core, and more.

Purchase "Elite Hunter Supplies" to unlock additional rewards as you rank up, including Annulith x680, Solid Dice x4, Fabricated Dice x2, Arc-light Trove II x1, A Handwritten Letter x2, Fons x950,000, and more!

Purchase this season's "Honor Hunter Supplies" to get all the extra rewards listed above, plus instantly receive the "Pukaboo" avatar, the "Puka Adventure" avatar frame, the "Pukaland Journal" namecard, Fabricated Dice x5, A Handwritten Letter x1, and Fons x500,000!

※ Open Arc-light Trove II to choose one of the following: Fluff of Fearlessness, Fluff of Fleetness, Fluff of Finesse, Fluff of Ferocity, Fluff of Fortitude, or Fons x2,000,000.

● "Blackbird's Invitation" Web Event

Duration: September 30, 11:00 – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: During the event, share your personal invite link to bring new and returning Appraisers into the event. Each invite code can be linked to up to 20 new Appraiser accounts and 20 returning Appraiser accounts. Once linked, accounts cannot be unlinked.

Complete quests on the event page to earn Annulith or Divination Attempts. Spend Divination Attempts for a chance to win Solid Dice x10 and other rewards.

You can also enter the redeem code from the event page in-game to claim a limited avatar frame.

※ Rewards cannot be claimed after the event ends. Be sure to claim them in time.

\

◆ Add a new cosmetic system: Accessories

◆ Add multiplayer to "Volley Star"

◆ Add a follow-cam mode to "Photo Mode - Drone Mode"

◆ Add new collectible types to "Going, Going, Gone!", plus a new Auction Assistant: Blackbird

◆ Add "Sweetdream Charity Drive" to City Tycoon: donate specific items to directly boost your Fons progress

◆ Increase Fons accumulation speed in the original City Tycoon Program

◆ Increase Hunter Supplies level cap to Lvl 80 and boost rewards beyond Lvl 50

◆ Add a "Bulk Gift" button to the Bond interface, so you can quickly redeem or purchase gifts and max out Bond Levels

◆ Add "First Meeting Replay" to the Character interface: linger for a bit to play the character's unlock animation (enable it under Settings › Control › First Meeting Replay)

◆ Add friend recommendations to the Friends interface

◆ Move "Fighting with a Dragon" to Spinoffs

◆ Allow placing Figurines anywhere on your Property, or displaying them in a Figurine Cabinet.

◆ Add Bond quests for Blackbird

◆ Add Bond interactions for Blackbird: reach the required Bond Level to unlock her passenger seat ride-along.

◆ Add a combat tutorial for Blackbird

◆ Improve controller support for Linko's Life Skill

◆ Fix an issue where Lacrimosa's Awakening Effect "Morning Spell" did not take effect when a Redirect Skill was used to cast Linko's "Ultimate: Oversync"

◆ Fix an issue where switching to Zankou after Linko cast "Ultimate: Oversync" displayed Zankou's Ultimate cooldown incorrectly when "Ultimate: Inferno Flamenco" had full Ultimate Energy but was still on cooldown

◆ Fix an issue where Linko's "Basic Attack: Spectral Rush" could sometimes lose its target

◆ Fix incorrect damage calculation when Linko triggers a Synced Strike

◆ Fix an issue where Linko could sometimes clip through models during the Hug interaction

◆ Fix missing sound effects for Iroi's jump and landing roll

◆ Fix an issue where some character outfits were missing their Awakening Lvl 6 visual effects

◆ Fix an issue where the achievement "Pinky Promise" could not be completed

◆ Fix crashes that could occur in certain situations.

◆ Improve localization for several languages.

◆ Fix other known issues.
